# Session Goal Template

Use this only when adding a new fixed session to `35_SESSION_BACKLOG.md`.

```markdown
### S### — <Short outcome name> — TODO

**Gate:** N#

**Class:** PLAY | PLATFORM | PRESENTATION | CONTENT | SPIKE

**Player/designer value:** <one observable sentence>

**Prerequisites:** <session IDs or none>

**Deliver:**

- <required result>
- <required result>

**Proof:**

- <automated proof>
- <playable/manual proof>

**Out:**

- <tempting adjacent work explicitly excluded>
- <another exclusion>

**Completion evidence:**

- added only when DONE
```

## Quality test

A good session title can complete this sentence:

> After this session, a player/designer can now ______.

If the answer is "the architecture is cleaner," rewrite it around the concrete capability or proof that requires the change.
